question: Which bowlers have the most consecutive T20I innings with at least one wicket for Full Member sides?
query: WITH bowler_innings AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS took_wicket FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id, took_wicket ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS grp FROM bowler_innings ), streaks AS ( SELECT bowler_id, took_wicket, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked WHERE took_wicket = 1 GROUP BY bowler_id, grp, took_wicket ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.streak_len) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_wickets AS (
    SELECT
        d.bowler_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL 
                  AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 
                                           'obstructing the field', 'handled the ball', 
                                           'timed out', 'hit the ball twice') 
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_innings
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.bowling_team IN ('Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 
                             'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 
                             'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe')
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
wicket_innings_only AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        match_id,
        inning,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id, inning) AS rn
    FROM innings_wickets
    WHERE wickets_in_innings >= 1
),
consecutive_groups AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        rn,
        rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY rn) AS grp
    FROM wicket_innings_only
),
consecutive_streaks AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        COUNT(*) AS consecutive_innings
    FROM consecutive_groups
    GROUP BY bowler_id, grp
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    MAX(cs.consecutive_innings) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket
FROM consecutive_streaks cs
JOIN Players p ON cs.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY cs.bowler_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC, p.player_name
LIMIT 10;

query: WITH batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2025/26' AND d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id ), openers AS ( SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id FROM (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY first_ball) AS rn FROM batting_order) sub WHERE rn <= 2 ), pp_out AS ( SELECT match_id, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number <= 5 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL ), survival AS ( SELECT o.match_id, o.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN po.player_out_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS survived FROM openers o LEFT JOIN pp_out po ON po.match_id = o.match_id AND po.player_out_id = o.striker_id GROUP BY o.match_id, o.batting_team ) SELECT batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN survived = 2 THEN 1 END) AS both_survived_pp FROM survival GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY both_survived_pp DESC;

query: WITH career_batting AS ( SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS career_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id ), career_bowling AS ( SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS career_wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, cb.career_runs, cw.career_wickets FROM career_batting cb JOIN career_bowling cw ON cb.striker_id = cw.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON cb.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE cb.career_runs >= 1000 AND cw.career_wickets >= 50 ORDER BY cb.career_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which teams’ openers have survived the Powerplay the most times in 2026 T20 World Cup?
query: WITH batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2025/26' AND d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id ), openers AS ( SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id FROM (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY first_ball) AS rn FROM batting_order) sub WHERE rn <= 2 ), pp_out AS ( SELECT match_id, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number <= 5 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL ), survival AS ( SELECT o.match_id, o.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN po.player_out_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS survived FROM openers o LEFT JOIN pp_out po ON po.match_id = o.match_id AND po.player_out_id = o.striker_id GROUP BY o.match_id, o.batting_team ) SELECT batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN survived = 2 THEN 1 END) AS both_survived_pp FROM survival GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY both_survived_pp DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH PowerplaySurvivals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.striker_id,
        MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_delivery
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026' 
      AND m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
      AND d.over_number < 6
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.striker_id
),
OpenerSurvivals AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.match_id,
        ps.batting_team,
        ps.striker_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN ps.first_delivery = (
                SELECT MIN(d2.delivery_id)
                FROM Deliveries d2
                WHERE d2.match_id = ps.match_id 
                  AND d2.batting_team = ps.batting_team
            ) THEN 1
            WHEN ps.first_delivery = (
                SELECT MIN(d2.delivery_id)
                FROM Deliveries d2
                WHERE d2.match_id = ps.match_id 
                  AND d2.batting_team = ps.batting_team
                  AND d2.striker_id != (
                      SELECT d3.striker_id
                      FROM Deliveries d3
                      WHERE d3.match_id = ps.match_id 
                        AND d3.batting_team = ps.batting_team
                      ORDER BY d3.delivery_id
                      LIMIT 1
                  )
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_opener
    FROM PowerplaySurvivals ps
),
OpenerNotOutInPowerplay AS (
    SELECT 
        os.match_id,
        os.batting_team,
        os.striker_id
    FROM OpenerSurvivals os
    WHERE os.is_opener = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Deliveries d
          WHERE d.match_id = os.match_id
            AND d.striker_id = os.striker_id
            AND d.over_number < 6
            AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
      )
)
SELECT 
    batting_team
FROM OpenerNotOutInPowerplay
GROUP BY batting_team
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS team, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches_taken FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id WHERE m.stage = 'Group' AND d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY d.bowling_team ORDER BY total_catches_taken DESC LIMIT 1;

FROM 
    Deliveries d
    JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id AND d.match_id = p.match_id

question: Which bowlers have conceded the most runs in their first-ever over in T20 season 2026?

question: What are the top two highest-scoring partnerships at the best run rates in season 2026?
query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs, ROUND(SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS run_rate FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, wicket_num HAVING SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) >= 50 ) SELECT p.runs, p.run_rate, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.run_rate DESC LIMIT 2;
generated_sql:
WITH PartnershipRuns AS (
    SELECT
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        d.striker_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
),
PartnershipRate AS (
    SELECT
        pr.match_id,
        pr.inning,
        pr.batting_team,
        pr.striker_id,
        pr.non_striker_id,
        pr.runs,
        pr.legal_balls,
        (pr.runs * 600.0) / NULLIF(pr.legal_balls, 0) AS run_rate
    FROM PartnershipRuns pr
    WHERE pr.legal_balls > 0
)
SELECT
    p1.player_name AS player1,
    p2.player_name AS player2,
    pr.runs,
    pr.run_rate
FROM PartnershipRate pr
JOIN Players p1 ON pr.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON pr.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY pr.run_rate DESC, pr.runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

                   COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id AND d.bowler_id = p2.player_id AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON d.bowler_id = p2.player_id
WHERE p1.player_name = 'Finn Allen' AND p2.player_name = 'Lungi Ngidi';

question: What are the highest partnership aggregates in a season 2026?

        d.batting_team,

question: What are the most consecutive wins in Men’s T20 World Cups?
query: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(consecutive_wins) AS most_consecutive_wins
FROM (
    SELECT 
        match_winner,
        match_date,
        SUM(1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY match_winner 
            ORDER BY match_date 
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) - SUM(
            CASE WHEN result_type = 'no result' OR result_type = 'tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY match_winner 
            ORDER BY match_date 
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS running_wins
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
) subquery
GROUP BY match_winner;

question: What are the fastest hundreds in T20Is (by balls faced)?
query: WITH innings_data AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 ) SELECT p.player_name, id.runs, id.balls_faced, id.not_out, m.season FROM innings_data id JOIN Players p ON id.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON id.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY id.balls_faced ASC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.striker_id,
    d.delivery_id,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id 
      ORDER BY d.delivery_id 
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id 
      ORDER BY d.delivery_id 
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS balls_faced
  FROM Deliveries d
),
hundreds AS (
  SELECT 
    striker_id,
    MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_for_hundred
  FROM innings_runs
  WHERE cumulative_runs >= 100
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
)
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  h.balls_for_hundred
FROM hundreds h
JOIN Players p ON h.striker_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY h.balls_for_hundred ASC;

question: Which teams have played consecutive T20 World Cup finals?

question: What is India’s head-to-head record against England in T20Is and T20 World Cups?

question: पुरुष T20 World Cup के नॉकआउट मैचों में सबसे अधिक मैच किसने खेले हैं?
query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS knockout_appearances FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON pim.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY knockout_appearances DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM Players p
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id

question: सीज़न 2026 में Sikandar Raza ने Ravi Bishnoi के खिलाफ कैसा प्रदर्शन किया है?
query: SELECT p_bat.player_name AS batter, p_bowl.player_name AS bowler, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out') THEN 1 END),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored)*100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS strike_rate FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_bat ON d.striker_id = p_bat.player_id JOIN Players p_bowl ON d.bowler_id = p_bowl.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p_bat.player_name LIKE '%Raza%' AND p_bowl.player_name LIKE '%Bishnoi%' AND m.season = '2026' GROUP BY p_bat.player_name, p_bowl.player_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS runs_scored,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id AND d.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 END) AS fours,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id AND d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 END) AS sixes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.striker_id = p1.player_id AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END), 0) AS strike_rate
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p1 ON p1.player_name = 'Sikandar Raza'
JOIN Players p2 ON p2.player_name = 'Ravi Bishnoi'
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = '2026'
    AND d.bowling_team = (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p1.player_id AND match_id = m.match_id)
    AND d.batting_team = (SELECT team_name FROM PlayerInMatch WHERE player_id = p2.player_id AND match_id = m.match_id)
    AND d.bowler_id = p2.player_id;

question: Which teams have lost multiple T20 World Cup finals?

question: T20 World Cup नॉकआउट में टीम के 100 रन पूरे करने के सबसे तेज़ रिकॉर्ड कौन से हैं?
query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date,
       d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs,
       MAX(d.over_number * 6 + d.ball_number) AS balls_faced
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') AND d.batting_team IN (m.team1, m.team2)
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) >= 100
ORDER BY balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: Who are the captains with the best win percentage in T20Is (Full Member teams, min 20 matches)?
query: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches_played, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = pim.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.match_id) AS win_percentage FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pim.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'South Africa', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Zimbabwe', 'Afghanistan', 'Ireland') GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(m.match_id) >= 20 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH captain_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.toss_winner AS captain,
        m.match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.match_winner = m.toss_winner THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS win
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe')
      AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe')
),
captain_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        captain,
        COUNT(*) AS matches,
        SUM(win) AS wins
    FROM captain_matches
    GROUP BY captain
    HAVING matches >= 20
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM captain_stats cs
JOIN Players p ON cs.captain = p.player_name
ORDER BY (wins * 100.0 / matches) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20Is లో అత్యధిక విజయ శాతం ఉన్న కెప్టెన్లు ఎవరు (Full Member జట్లు, కనిష్టం 20 మ్యాచ్‌లు)?
query: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches_played, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = pim.team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.match_id) AS win_percentage FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pim.team_name IN ('India', 'Australia', 'England', 'South Africa', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Bangladesh', 'Zimbabwe', 'Afghanistan', 'Ireland') GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(m.match_id) >= 20 ORDER BY win_percentage DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 AND m.toss_winner = m.team1 THEN 1
             WHEN m.match_winner = m.team2 AND m.toss_winner = m.team2 THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.match_id) AS win_percentage
FROM 
    Matches m
JOIN 
    Players p ON m.toss_winner = p.player_id
WHERE 
    m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe')
    AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan', 'Australia', 'Bangladesh', 'England', 'India', 'Ireland', 'New Zealand', 'Pakistan', 'South Africa', 'Sri Lanka', 'West Indies', 'Zimbabwe')
    AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(m.match_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    win_percentage DESC;

question: T20 World Cup ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੈਮੀਫਾਈਨਲ ਅਤੇ ਫਾਈਨਲ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 50 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
query: WITH km AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season ORDER BY m.match_date DESC) AS rnk FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), final_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ), semi_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk IN (2,3) GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ) SELECT p.player_name, ss.season FROM semi_scores ss JOIN final_scores fs ON ss.striker_id = fs.striker_id AND ss.season = fs.season JOIN Players p ON ss.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ss.season;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id

  AND m.season = '2022'

question: T20 World Cups ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 50-ਪਲੱਸ ਸਕੋਰ ਕਿਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਹਨ?
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: WITH km AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season ORDER BY m.match_date DESC) AS rnk FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), final_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ), semi_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk IN (2,3) GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ) SELECT p.player_name, ss.season FROM semi_scores ss JOIN final_scores fs ON ss.striker_id = fs.striker_id AND ss.season = fs.season JOIN Players p ON ss.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ss.season;

question: T20 World Cups లో వరుసగా అత్యధిక 50+ స్కోర్లు చేసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు?
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH innings_halves AS (

        d.inning,

question: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH innings_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
        m.match_date
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.stage LIKE '%World Cup%'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, m.match_date
),
ordered_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        runs,
        match_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS rn
    FROM innings_scores
),
consecutive_50s AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_date,
        rn,
        rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS grp
    FROM ordered_scores
    WHERE runs >= 50
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length
    FROM consecutive_50s
    GROUP BY striker_id, grp
)
SELECT

FROM Players p
JOIN streaks s ON p.player_id = s.striker_id

question: T20 World Cup ਫਾਈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੇਜ਼ਿੰਗ ਬਨਾਮ ਬਚਾਅ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;

question: T20 World Cups ਵਿੱਚ India ਬਨਾਮ New Zealand ਦਾ ਆਹਮਣੇ-ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS india_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = 'New Zealand' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nz_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL OR m.result_type = 'tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result_tie, COUNT(*) AS total_matches, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season || ' ' || COALESCE(m.city,''), ', ') AS matches_detail FROM Matches m WHERE ((m.team1 = 'India' AND m.team2 = 'New Zealand') OR (m.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND m.team2 = 'India'));
